t458_infrastructure_summary.headline: T458 needs no new hosts, no Docker, no paid API access -- it deliberately reuses this repo's existing Claude Code agent-dispatch mechanism, not a Terminal-Bench-shaped harness. What it needs is new software: a two-arm (control/treatment) session dispatcher using the existing dispatch primitive twice per case with @context-retriever selectively available, git-worktree-style per-trial isolation (same pattern every subagent this session already used), a brief.md-to-live-session-to-candidate-output pipeline, a bridge into expect.py's existing check(case_dir) contract pointed at the live candidate directory instead of the checked-in fixture (a protected-path exception request if expect.py's signature can't cleanly take an alternate directory -- pre-approval required, not a silent workaround), and a pre-registered 'measurably improve' threshold written before any comparison run.
t458_infrastructure_summary.explicit_non_requirements: No Docker daemon, no container runtime, no host provisioning/resizing, no metered model API (a genuine need for one would be a type:external/severity:critical blocker requiring explicit cost authorization first, mirroring T407's money gate), no changes to tests/golden/**, scripts/scorecard.py, or tb-subset.*, no .mcp.json involvement.
t458_infrastructure_summary.honest_scope_risk: Both task-T458.md and plan-040 explicitly refuse to pre-commit to 'medium' scope -- T407's own mid-flight re-scoping into 'Design A' is the named precedent for what might need to happen here too. Report a real need for multi-task re-sequencing as an expected outcome, not a failure, if that's what investigation finds.
